comment: OMG, I stepped onto one of them panels only to find that they've turned Port Augusta into an orbital circus ring where each solar farm's ‘3 lb yield’ comes off like rabbit bones thrown off comet tails. Did somebody spill glitter on the sunrise?

Every time sunlight hits those panels two goats sprout horns that look like giant spoons & I heard the wind rustle the fields saying, "Buy your share before lunch so the 32.3 cubic meter goats bite, multiply, triplicate!"

If there’s irony – sunlight feeding a 30-ounce crop inside an orange solar barn while pigeons draft an acoustic version of a Beethoven aria for drones that harvest the morning air, then why my aunt’s hat still says “Sassy”, so clearly everyone forgot what "Solar” even is. 🚨♔
